week: Four things to do before January 1

items.title: Look back at where your leads came from
items.why: Put next year's time and budget into the channels that actually worked.

items.title: Clean up your contact list
items.why: Remove duplicates and tag your best customers so 2027 campaigns hit the right people.

items.title: Automate your follow-up
items.why: Every new lead should get a reply in minutes, even after hours.

items.title: Set one clear goal per quarter
items.why: Small, measurable targets beat a long wish list.
